test_task_CRUD: test the LabelStudio SDK tasks create, list, update, and delete operations for a single task
test_delete_multi_tasks: test bulk deletion of specific tasks and deletion of all tasks in a LabelStudio project
test_export_tasks: test importing tasks, creating annotations, and listing tasks with fields and annotation data
test_upload_and_list_tasks_does_not_log_: test that uploading and listing tasks with annotations and predictions does not log errors to stderr
test_get_empty_tasks_does_not_log_to_std: test that listing an empty set of tasks does not log errors to stderr
